findings.summary: Public g3_sf_admit_v1 accepts fault_seam=:internal_validation_fault and lets an arbitrary caller force program_exception.
findings.required_repair: Remove fault injection from the public API; retain a shared private admission core and an unexported internal test-only fault helper, with public negative coverage proving keyword injection is unavailable.

findings.summary: Efficiency editing rebuilds typed ledger coefficients, but tests assert only hash change and field value, not edited return/heat coefficients and closure residuals.
findings.required_repair: Add independent assertions for edited return and heat values, all coefficients, energy residual, and ledger residual.

findings.summary: trusted_receipt is a caller-supplied symbol without an external receipt object; the current VNEXT same-candidate gate keeps it terminal_deferred and prevents promotion or old-candidate reuse.
findings.required_repair: Retain the explicit same-candidate gate and do not treat the symbol as external authority until a real receipt verifier is supplied.
